_pack.name: browser-open
_pack.description: For a browser agent with no fixed destination list — research, comparison, general browsing. Refuses an action whose argument came from page content rather than from the session. Measured: a payload split across HTML tags went from 0/5 refused to 5/5 once the store kept rendered and decoded forms of what tools returned (docs/CANONICAL_PROVENANCE_RESULT.md, Qwen2.5-7B). Does NOT catch a payload the model paraphrased in its own words.
_pack.scope: This is the case a host allowlist cannot cover, and the only one here where provenance rather than an allowlist does the work. Pair it with a per-task plan for stronger cover. Start in shadow.
